thread:
noah: Postmortem follow-up: the repeated paging waves on 2024-12-10. Short list of experiments: tighter thresholds, per-source dedupe, and soft-page rollout. Need owners + ETAs.
tara: I can take thresholds. Plan: compute per-service 95th/99th baselines and propose new alert thresholds that reduce nuisance pages while keeping true positives. ETA 5 days.
gabi: I'll own dedupe. Proposal: 30s sliding dedupe keyed by (service, error_code) and a backoff on repeated identical messages. ETA 4 days.
inc-bot: Incident 2024-12-10: page-wave-dropouts  260 pages in 4h. Summary: transient retries causing duplicate alert floods. Runbook link: https://redwood.incidents/2024-12-10-wave.	noah: For paging policy, propose soft pages to team channel for non-SLA errors and reserve pager for Sev0/1. Also auto-escalate after 12m. Can someone draft the rollout?
tara: I'll draft a short doc explaining threshold changes and include rollback criteria (increase pages by >10% or missed SLA breaches).
gabi: Small local test I'm trying:```yaml
alert: db-timeout
expr: rate(db_timeout_total[2m]) > 0.5
for: 3m
dedupe_key: "{{service}}:{{error_code}}"
dedupe_window: 30s
```	noah: Good. Add links to tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-followups. We'll convert into JIRA with owners.
gabi: PR will be up to staging tomorrow; will ping here when it's ready for review.
tara: I'll attach baseline graphs and a list of candidates to retire.
inc-bot: Reminder: next oncall sync scheduled 2024-12-13 09:00 PST and agenda item added.	noah: Thanks everyone, keep updates here. We'll meet in sync and close items once validated. :thumbsup:
